nodes.label: Docker Compose Local Stack
nodes.rationale: Three containers — jobocate-mongodb (27017), jobocate-backend (8000), jobocate-frontend (3000) — brought up with `docker-compose up --build`. Source is bind-mounted so hot reload works for both tiers with no rebuild; MongoDB data persists in a named Docker volume by design, and `down -v` is the documented reset.

nodes.label: OAuth redirect_uri_mismatch Troubleshooting
nodes.rationale: Google OAuth must have http://localhost:8000/api/auth/google/callback as an authorized redirect URI and localhost:3000/8000 as JS origins. Changes take 5-10 minutes to propagate at Google, which is why the mismatch error commonly appears immediately after configuring — remedy is wait, clear cache, or use incognito.

nodes.label: MongoDB Container Management & Backup
nodes.rationale: mongosh is reached via `docker-compose exec mongodb mongosh jobocate`; backup/restore use mongodump/mongorestore with --archive piped through exec -T.
